title: Aneutronic p-B11 Fusion: Long-Term Pathway Assessment and Direct-Conversion Architecture

claims: A staged laser-magnetic heating architecture for proton-boron-11 fusion comprising: (a) a picosecond laser pre-heat stage; (b) a pulsed magnetic compression stage; (c) a sustained alpha-burn stage.
An inverse-cyclotron direct converter with staged deceleration electrodes for converting charged fusion products to electricity.
A closed-loop boron-11 enrichment and recycling system for aneutronic fusion reactors.

extra.abstract: Long-term feasibility assessment of p-B11 fusion with three patentable sub-systems identified.
